what_this_is: The programs a person applies to before they can pay (an offer row with `apply_path`), read by src/client-program.mjs. Each program names its offer, the host who takes clients (an account named by a Worker setting), and the audience the host's Clients screen is offered to (src/workspace/surfaces.json). `apply` holds every word of the application screen: its boxes (`fields`, each a name, label and example; `required` ones must be filled), and what it says in each state (not applied, applied, accepted, a client). `notice` is how the host is told of an application (a kind in records/tell-the-person.json, with {name} and the other answers filled in), `accepted_notice` how the applicant is told they were accepted. `accept` holds the words of accepting. `space` is the space a purchase opens between the client and the host: its label (src/network-settings.json), its title with {client} and {host}, and the rule that shares each decision the client works on into it (`when` as set_rule takes it; `tool_id` a tool on placement:this-account). `feed` holds the words of the host's Clients screen, where applications and every client's decisions are read together. A new program, host or wording is a row here; nothing in code names one.
